# AI.MAGED — Curated Books

## About
AI.MAGED is a focused library of carefully selected books across subjects, genres, languages, and formats. Books are added deliberately and are never published automatically.

## Sitemap
https://aimaged.com/sitemap.xml

## Key Pages
- Homepage: https://aimaged.com
- Books: https://aimaged.com/books
- About: https://aimaged.com/about
- Contact: https://aimaged.com/contact

## Content Model
Every public book can include:
- Title and subtitle
- Author
- Subject or category
- Language
- Description
- Tags
- Publication year
- ISBN
- Format
- A public book link or public file when the owner explicitly enables it

## Editorial Rule
Only books selected and explicitly published by the site owner appear in the public library. No random or automatic book uploads are used.

## Future
The platform is designed to support additional content such as courses later without changing the core public experience.
